# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Path and glyph rendering corrections**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 gains upstream fixes for clipped paths, glyph replay and Graphite readback. These updates retain Skia milestone 156 and leave managed wrappers and generated bindings unchanged.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Clipped paths and coverage masks** — Corrects Ganesh device-space path bounds and coverage-mask subset clamping, plus Graphite clip-key packing and wedge miter bounds. Convex anti-aliased rasterization fixes prevent run-buffer overflow around clip gaps; custom builds defining SK_LEGACY_ALPHA_RUNS do not enable that new raster behavior. ([#5617](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5617), [#5631](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5631))
- **Validated glyph replay** — Validates serialized Slug positions, transforms, bounds and flags, preserves creation-time rounding, and bounds direct-mask offsets. Ganesh and Graphite reject unsuitable replay data when glyph-atlas bilinear sampling is unavailable, retaining rendering fallbacks. ([#5617](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5617), [#5624](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5624))
- **Complete Graphite readback pixels** — Fixes the destination pixel-size mismatch when transferring an alpha texture to an RGBx color type, preventing incorrect row stepping and unwritten destination bytes. ([#5631](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5631))
